Class PulsarReaderEndpointRegistrar

java.lang.Object
org.apache.pulsar.spring.config.PulsarReaderEndpointRegistrar
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aware, BeanFactoryAware, InitializingBean
public class PulsarReaderEndpointRegistrar extends Object implements BeanFactoryAware, InitializingBean
Helper bean for registering PulsarReaderEndpoint with a GenericReaderEndpointRegistry.
